title: The Doom Patrol #3
desc:
THE STRANGEST AND MOST WONDROUS NEXT LEVEL SERIES ENTER THE EVERVOID!

The Doom Patrol has arrived at the remote location of its newest assignment: the Evervoid Compound—home to a mysterious cult, a not-so-mysterious old foe, and the young girl who's been haunting Dr. Caulder's nightmares.

Can the World's Strangest Heroes finish this unusual assignment before it finishes them? And just who is the young girl haunting Dr. Caulder—and why has she been made manifest?
